BrochureContent.Content:
Forkin Earls Property are delighted to present a rare opportunity to acquire two adjoining, self-contained homes in the heart of the picturesque village of Redcross, Co. Wicklow. Occupying a generous site of approximately 0.5 acres and extending to approximately 180 sq. m. (1,950 sq. ft.), this unique property offers exceptional flexibility for investors, multi-generational families, or purchasers seeking a home with supplementary rental income. Each residence enjoys its own private entrance, ensuring privacy and independence.

Ideally positioned on Main Street, just 15 minutes from both Wicklow Town and Arklow, the property enjoys the perfect balance of peaceful village living and convenient access to an extensive range of amenities, schools, transport links, and the M11 motorway.

“Tara House” is a charming period residence brimming with character and retaining a number of original features. The well-proportioned accommodation comprises three spacious bedrooms, two bathrooms, a welcoming living room, a fitted kitchen, and a bright conservatory overlooking the beautiful rear garden. A truly unique feature is the magnificent grapevine, believed to be approximately 200 years old, which creates a stunning focal point within the conservatory.

“Hillview” provides comfortable, modern accommodation comprising two bedrooms, a bright living room, kitchen, and family bathroom, making it ideal for extended family, guests, or rental use.

Both homes are presented in excellent condition and benefit from oil-fired central heating, complemented by a multi-fuel stove with back boiler, providing warmth and efficiency throughout.

To the rear, the mature south-facing garden offers a wonderfully private outdoor space with an abundance of planting and colour. A substantial workshop/shed provides excellent storage or workspace, while double-gated rear access and the generous site offer exciting future development potential, subject to the necessary planning permission.

Redcross is a thriving and highly regarded village with an impressive range of amenities all within easy walking distance, including a supermarket, cafés, restaurants, Wicklow Brewery, the renowned Mickey Finn's Gastro Pub, Rua's Pub, a primary school, crèche, church, sports facilities, tennis and padel courts, a bowling green, wine bar, and a community sports hall.

The surrounding area is renowned for its outstanding natural beauty. The Blue Flag beaches of Brittas Bay, Beyond the Trees at Avondale, Avoca, Avondale House, Aughrim, and Glendalough are all within easy reach. Golf enthusiasts are exceptionally well catered for, with The European Club, Woodenbridge Golf Club, and Blainroe Golf Club all nearby, while the Wicklow Hills provide endless opportunities for walking, cycling, and a wide variety of outdoor pursuits.

The M11 motorway is less than 10 minutes away, providing excellent connectivity to Dublin, Wexford, and beyond. Both Wicklow Town and Arklow are approximately a 15-minute drive and offer an extensive selection of supermarkets, shops, secondary schools, leisure facilities, restaurants, and public transport services.
Combining period charm, modern comfort, outstanding versatility, and exciting future potential, Tara House and Hillview represent a truly unique opportunity to acquire an exceptional property in one of County Wicklow's most sought-after village locations. 

Early viewing is highly recommended and is strictly by appointment.

Tara House - Entrance Hall/Cloakroom - 
Tiled floor, alcove with good storage and cloakroom space. Door opening into the living area.

Living Room - 
A welcoming living room featuring exposed stonework, partly painted and partly left in its natural finish. A feature spiral staircase leads to the first floor. The room also benefits from a multi-fuel stove with back boiler, dual-aspect windows overlooking the front and side of the property, a door leading to the conservatory, and carpet flooring.

Dining Room / Bedroom 3 - 
A bright and spacious dining room with a feature fireplace, raised stone hearth, exposed stonework, sliding door to an alcove area, and carpet flooring.

Hallway - 
Hallway with built-in shelving.

Kitchen - 
Well fitted with a good range of floor and eye-level units. Plumbed for a washing machine and dishwasher with tiled splashbacks between the floor and wall units. Vinyl flooring. Dual-aspect windows provide lovely views over the garden.

Bathroom - 
Comprising WC, WHB, and a corner shower fitted with an electric Triton T90S shower.

Conservatory - 
The conservatory features a magnificent grapevine tree believed to be approximately 200 years old, tiled flooring, and a door opening onto the garden.

First Floor - 
A feature spiral staircase leads to the first floor.

Bedroom 1 - 
A large open-plan double bedroom with dual-aspect windows, solid wooden flooring, and a feature granite windowsill.

Landing Area - 
A generous landing area providing an ideal space for a study or home office.

Bedroom 2 - 
Large double bedroom with wooden flooring, feature open fireplace (not in use), built-in storage, and windows overlooking the front of the property.

Bathroom - 
Comprising WC, WHB, and a corner shower. Tiled flooring.

Hillview House- Entrance Hallway - 
Entrance hallway with stairs leading to the first floor. Carpet flooring.

Kitchen - 
Fitted with a good range of floor and eye-level units. Plumbed for a washing machine and dishwasher, with an integrated oven, electric hob, and extractor hood. Laminate wood flooring and door opening onto the patio area.

First Floor Landing - 
Carpet flooring with window overlooking the rear garden.

Bedroom 1 - 
Double bedroom with wooden flooring. Built-in shelved hot-press, clothes rail, and shelving.

Bedroom 2 - 
Double bedroom overlooking front of the property, with carpet flooring.

Bathroom - 
Comprising WC, WHB, bath with shower overhead, partially tiled walls around the bath, and vinyl flooring.

Outside - 
Mature gardens with a variety of plants, shrubs, apple and pear trees. Patio area, attractive stonework, and granite features around the garden. Spacious workshop/garage and timber storage sheds provide excellent outdoor storage. Double gates to the front allow convenient vehicular access.

Services - 
Mains Water, sewage, electricity.Oil-fired central heating with multi-fuel stove and back boiler.Both broadband and satellite are available in the area.

• Unique opportunity to acquire two adjoining, self-contained homes on one generous 0.42-acre site, each with its own private entrance.
  • Approx. 180 sq. m. (1,950 sq. ft.) of combined accommodation with mature gardens, double-gated access, ample off-street parking, and potential for future development (subject to planning permission).
  • Ideal for multi-generational living, investment, or rental income, offering flexibility for a variety of buyers.
  • Prime Main Street location in Redcross village, within walking distance of shops, cafés, restaurants, schools, and sports facilities.
  • Tara House is a charming period residence with three bedrooms and many original features, while Hillview House is a modern, self-contained two-bedroom home.
  • Bright conservatory overlooking the gardens, featuring a remarkable 200-year-old grapevine.
  • Spacious workshop/shed providing excellent storage, workspace, or hobby potential.
  • Excellent connectivity, with the M11 Motorway less than 10 minutes away and Wicklow Town and Arklow approximately 15 minutes by car.
  • Conveniently located close to Brittas Bay, Glendalough, Avondale, The European Club, Woodenbridge Golf Club, and Blainroe Golf Club.
